safeCommunity.title: Safe Community
safeCommunity.description: At SayNative we foster a space of mutual respect and learning. Harassment, inappropriate language or misconduct are strictly prohibited with zero tolerance.
safeCommunity.guidelinesMessage: SayNative promotes respect, diversity, and integrity. Harassment, sensitive content, and discrimination are strictly prohibited.

privacy.hideAgeDesc: Other students will only see your country of residence and language proficiency level.
privacy.reputationFilterDesc: Only accept voice/video requests from peers with ratings above 4.0 stars.
privacy.antiShockDesc: Blurs the incoming camera feed during the first 5 seconds of each call until you confirm connection.

blockedUsers.description: Restricted users cannot message you, listen to your audio notes, or join your rooms.
blockedUsers.unblockConfirmMessage: Do you want to unblock {{name}}? They will be able to interact with you again.

moderation.reportsStatusDesc: We review each case in under 24 hours...
moderation.reportsModalMessage: Your community conduct report is currently being reviewed by the Trust & Safety team.
moderation.complianceText: We strictly adhere to Google Play and Apple App Store safety standards. Any content threatening physical, psychological, or sexual integrity leads to immediate expulsion and reporting to legal authorities.
moderation.deleteAccountButton: Delete my account and personal data
moderation.deleteAccountWarning: This action is irreversible and will permanently delete your progress, exchange history, and coins.
moderation.deleteConfirmMessage: This action cannot be undone. All your personal data, coin balance, and chats will be permanently deleted from our servers.

toasts.privacyUpdatedMessage: Your privacy settings have been saved.
toasts.antiShockEnabledMessage: Incoming video will be blurred for the first 5 seconds.
toasts.accountDeletedMessage: Your account and personal data have been removed from the system.
